hooks.scope: three diagnostic/helper Python files, profile evidence, implementation plan and all eleven diagnostic JSON artifacts

limitations: One sample per configuration, no causal before/after speed claim.
All ten diagnostic runs used fresh processes, sequentially, without concurrent test/lint jobs.
Initial mixed test/lint smoke run is excluded from timing evidence.
cProfile measures main-thread execution, not total worker execution/IPC latency.
Raw .prof files are local /tmp artifacts; portable summaries/callers/source hashes are retained here.
No full candidate rerun; historical 2206/7 remains historical.
No production code, frozen budgets or acceptance manifest changed in this diagnostic increment.
